title: Serveo stable domain
summary: Reserved Serveo hostname bound to your own SSH key. The public URL survives restarts.
operatorPrepares: Generate an SSH key pair yourself.
Reserve the hostname in your Serveo account and bind that key to it.
Provide the private key path and the reserved label here.

notes.batch_mode: Must stay false. Serveo completes auth with an empty keyboard-interactive challenge even for registered keys; BatchMode disables that and breaks auth. Verified live 2026-07-17.
